quotes.text: In the age of Kali, intelligent persons perform congregational chanting to worship the incarnation of Godhead who constantly sings the names of Krishna.
The humble sages, by virtue of true knowledge, see with equal vision a learned and gentle brahmana, a cow, an elephant, a dog and a dog-eater.
The protection of cows is the single most important principle towards saving the whole world from both moral and spiritual degradation.
If one offers Me with love and devotion a leaf, a flower, fruit or water, I will accept it.
This material world is a place of suffering. One who knows this tries to make the best use of a bad bargain.
Agriculture and cow protection are the way to become sinless and thus be prepared for the next life.
